newsitem.title: ANGOLA: Heavy fighting reported in northeast Angola.
newsitem.headline: Heavy fighting reported in northeast Angola.

text.p: Heavily armed troops of Angola's former rebel movement UNITA are putting up strong resistance against a government army bid to oust them from the diamond-rich northeast, threatening Angola's fragile peace process, military and diplomatic sources said on Thursday.

A senior military source said UNITA may have thrown up to "six and seven battalions" into the battle and the government side was fighting with tanks, artillery and anti-aircraft cannon. Western diplomats said the fighting could restart the civil war which plagued Angola for 20 years.
